title: hotfix: SLO enforcer backoff/regional failover edgecase (race under burst)
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Hotfix: fixes rare race in SLO enforcer backoff that could prevent regional failover during burst; improves stability under high fan-out.
description: Motivation: We observed an incident where a short, high-concurrency traffic burst caused the SLO enforcer backoff and regional failover paths to race. In some cases the enforcer would aggressively back off a region while failover was triggered concurrently, causing mis-ordered decisions and longer-than-expected degradation (ENG-2123, SUP-893). This is a targeted hotfix to resolve the race and harden the decision ordering and metrics used by the enforcer. Summary of changes: 1) Introduce a small scoped 'decision_lock' to serialize final SLO decisions per-candidate-region for a single request id to avoid conflicting backoff <-> failover updates. 2) Add durable state transitions and idempotent compare-and-swap (CAS) for the enforcer's region-state store. 3) Throttle failover triggers for regions already in cooldown using the existing cooldown tokens (previously only used by backoff). 4) Add unit+integration test that simulates burst patterns and validates ordering. 5) Observability additions: add tracing span "slo.enforcer.decision" and new metric slo_enforcer.final_decision_latency_ms. Commits (high level): - fix(enforcer): serialize final decision writes with per-request lock - fix(enforcer): use CAS when updating region-state to prevent lost updates - test(enforcer): add burst/fanout integration test harness - docs: add note about cooldown tokens and decision ordering - ci: add flaky integration runner for enforcer tests Files changed (high level): - services/enforcer/src/decision_manager.rs: introduce DecisionLock and CAS logic, 120 lines changed - services/enforcer/src/state_store.rs: add idempotent updates and TTL adjustments - services/enforcer/tests/burst_integration.rs: new test harness simulating 200 concurrent requests - services/observability/tracing.rs: add slo.enforcer.decision span - docs/running/operational_guide.md: add note about cooldown tokens and troubleshooting - .github/workflows/enforcer-integration.yml: add flaky-run config Review conversation excerpt: - Ethan Brooks (reviewer): "Good approach serializing the final write — can you clarify performance impact for high QPS?" - Priya Nair (author): "DecisionLock is per-request-id and only around the final write path; I measured median added latency ~120us under load in our perf harness. Added a note in the code and a microbenchmark in tests." - Sofia Martinez (reviewer): "We should make sure the CAS path has a bounded retry to prevent tight loops under contention." - Priya Nair: "Added bounded backoff with jitter (max 3 retries) and documented it. Also added telemetry when retries > 0." - Luca Romano (approver): "Verified integration test runs stable locally; approving." CI and rollout: - CI: unit (pass), linters (pass), enforcer-integration (flaky-run) initially failed on first run due to race in test harness; re-ran and passed on second run. - Canary: rolled to 10% traffic for dedicated and hosted regions behind feature flag slo_enforcer_racefix. Observed no increase in errors and a small reduction in final decision latency. Merge: Squash and merge with commit message 'hotfix: serialize SLO enforcer decision writes; CAS state updates; add integration test (ENG-2123)'. Post-merge actions: - Backported the minimal state_store CAS change to the 2026-02 release branch (branch: release/2026-02-hotfix) in a separate cherry-pick PR. - Ops: scheduled a 1-hour monitoring window and a quick rollback plan (feature flag toggle) during the gradual 24h rollout. Notes: This fixes an edgecase that only appeared with high ephemeral concurrency (fan-out bursts to multiple regions). The fix is intentionally narrowly-scoped to avoid changing broader enforcer semantics; follow-ups planned to unify cooldown tokens and decision state machine (ENG-2101).
